historical_basis.quote: A leprechaun (Irish: lucharachán/leipreachán/luchorpán ) is a diminutive supernatural being in Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. They are usually depicted as little bearded men, wearing a coat and hat, who partake in mischief. In later times, they have been depicted as shoe-makers who have a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow.

statement.id: Leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) adalah makhluk gaib kecil cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), peri penyendiri (solitary fairy), lelaki kecil berjanggut yang usil, dan pembuat sepatu dengan sepanci emas di ujung pelangi.
statement.en: A leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, a solitary fairy, a little bearded man of mischief, and a shoemaker with a pot of gold at the rainbow's end.

historical_basis.quote: The leprechaun is said to be a solitary creature, whose principal occupation is making and cobbling shoes, and who enjoys practical jokes.

statement.id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri (solitary) yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu (shoes) dan gemar bercanda.
statement.en: The leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who enjoys practical jokes.

historical_basis.quote: According to William Butler Yeats, the great wealth of the leprechauns comes from the "treasure-crocks, buried of old in war-time", which they have uncovered and appropriated.

statement.id: Menurut William Butler Yeats, kekayaan leprechaun berasal dari guci harta (treasure-crocks) yang dikubur pada masa perang (war-time).
statement.en: According to William Butler Yeats, leprechauns' wealth comes from treasure-crocks buried in war-time.

historical_basis.quote: Before the 20th century, it was generally held that the leprechaun wore red, not green.

statement.id: Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dianggap berpakaian merah (red), bukan hijau (green).
statement.en: Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green.

historical_basis.quote: Menurut legenda, leprechaun memiliki sebuah gentong yang berisi emas. Gentong tersebut dikatakan di letakkan di ujung pelangi. Dikatakan bahwa siapapun yang berhasil mencuri gentong emas tersebut, maka sang dewa muslihat tersebut harus mengabulkan 3 permintaan jika gentongnya ingin dikembalikan.

statement.id: Menurut legenda, leprechaun punya gentong emas di ujung pelangi; pencurinya mendapat 3 permintaan sebagai ganti gentong itu.
statement.en: By legend the leprechaun has a pot of gold (gentong emas) at the rainbow's end (ujung pelangi); its thief gets 3 wishes (permintaan) for its return.
